content.json:
# Nutanix Health & Security
Operational and security posture for Nutanix Prism, sourced from the `Nutanix_CL` custom table. Use the time range control to adjust the window. Tiles and charts cover alerts, audit activity, events, and collector health.

content.title: Overview
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category != "test"
| summarize Count = count() by Metric = case(
    Category == "alert" and tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning"), "Critical/Warning Alerts",
    Category == "alert", "Other Alerts",
    Category == "audit" and tolower(Severity) == "failed", "Failed Audits",
    Category == "audit", "Audit Operations",
    Category == "event", "Events",
    "Other")
| order by Count desc

content.title: Alerts over time by severity
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Severity = tolower(Severity)

content.title: Top alert types (critical/warning)
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| where tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning")
| summarize Count = count() by OperationType
| top 10 by Count desc

content.title: Audit activity over time (by result)
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Result = tolower(Severity)

content.title: Most active users (audit)
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit" and isnotempty(ActorUser)
| summarize Operations = count() by ActorUser
| top 10 by Operations desc

content.title: Audit operations breakdown
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit" and isnotempty(OperationType)
| summarize Count = count() by OperationType
| top 12 by Count desc

content.title: Events over time
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "event"
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

content.json:
## Collector health
Confirms the collector is still ingesting. If 'Minutes since last record' climbs above your collection interval, the collector, scheduled task, credentials, or the path to Prism has failed.

content.title: Ingestion freshness
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| summarize LastRecord = max(TimeGenerated), TotalRecords = count()
| extend ['Minutes since last record'] = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastRecord)
| project ['Minutes since last record'], LastRecord, TotalRecords

content.title: Records ingested per hour
content.query:
Nutanix_CL
| summarize Records = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| where tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity = tolower(Severity), OperationType, NutanixClusterName, Title, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
